# SC-10: Settle the morning's exceptions list

## Steps
1. Open the exceptions list at the start of the day.
2. Settle each line: correct the code or note it for the customer.

## Expected result
Every line on the list is settled and moves to the order sheet or is marked for the customer (1 case).
